usage: Used to refer to memories of past events or experiences
Can be used as a noun (a memory) or a verb (to recall)
Often paired with 美好 / 痛苦 to describe the nature of a memory
Common in personal stories and reflective conversations

examples.sentence: 呢段回憶對我嚟講好珍貴。
examples.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 wui4 jik1 deoi3 ngo5 lei4 gong2 hou2 zan1 gwai3
examples.meaning: This memory is very precious to me.

examples.sentence: 每次回憶返以前嘅事，我都會笑。
examples.jyutping: mui5 ci3 wui4 jik1 faan1 ji5 cin4 ge3 si6, ngo5 dou1 wui5 siu3
examples.meaning: Every time I recall the past, I end up smiling.
